program.merge_policy: accumulate eight 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after 200

policy.validation_strategy: cheap duplicate/entity/source screening during authoring; expensive repository-wide validation only after Wave 700

waves.focus: Legacy randomized human nausea evidence; retain indication, pregnancy/clinical context if applicable, formulation and comparator boundaries.
Legacy randomized human fatigue evidence; preserve baseline B12 status and deficiency-vs-nondeficiency boundaries.
Legacy randomized human stress-response evidence; acute/chronic exposure and healthy-population boundaries remain explicit.
Legacy randomized exercise-performance evidence; preserve training context, outcome type and comparator.
Legacy randomized pilot evidence for inflammatory/pain outcomes; preparation, co-intervention and small-sample limits retained.
Legacy randomized cognition evidence; iron status, deficiency risk and population boundaries are essential.
Legacy large randomized osteoarthritis evidence with mixed symptomatic outcomes; formulation-specificity retained.
Legacy randomized oxidative-stress evidence; clinical context and biomarker-vs-clinical endpoint distinction retained.
Legacy limited randomized weight/metabolic evidence; proprietary preparation and short-duration boundaries retained.
Legacy randomized libido/energy evidence; sex, population and preparation boundaries retained.
Legacy randomized anxiety-score evidence; small-trial, population and dosing-context boundaries retained.
Legacy randomized metabolic-marker evidence; disease population and comparator boundaries retained.
Legacy randomized triglyceride evidence; EPA/DHA composition and baseline triglyceride status remain attached.
Legacy randomized anxiety evidence; extract identity, comparator and short-duration limits retained.
Legacy randomized memory evidence; extract identity, chronic exposure and cognitive-domain boundaries retained.
Legacy randomized focus/energy evidence; combination-only evidence cannot be attributed to caffeine or L-theanine alone.
Legacy randomized energy/blood-health evidence; baseline iron status and deficiency context retained.
Legacy randomized weight/gut-health evidence; formulation, energy-intake context and mixed weight outcomes retained.
Legacy small randomized cognition evidence; species/product identity and small-sample limits retained.
Legacy randomized fatigue evidence; baseline vitamin-C status and clinical context retained.
2026 systematic review/meta-analysis of lavender essential oil for adult sleep; essential-oil route is separate from oral Silexan or generic lavender exposure.
2026 GRADE-assessed meta-analysis of 34 RCTs for depression/anxiety/mood; large heterogeneity means pooled benefits require certainty and scale-specific calibration.
2026 umbrella review for knee osteoarthritis; integrates conflicting review-level efficacy, formulation differences and safety rather than assuming class-wide benefit.
2024 sleep systematic review/meta-analysis; PSQI improved but heterogeneity was very high, while daytime function and sleep efficiency were largely null/mixed.
2025 systematic review combining a small human RCT/pilot evidence base with extensive preclinical literature; human cognition claims must remain separated from laboratory mechanisms.
